summary_1line: Sikhandini gains temporary manhood from the Yaksha Sthunakarna to save her family and prove herself male, averting conflict with the Dasarna king.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a lonely forest mansion, the Yaksha Sthunakarna magically exchanges sexes with the desperate princess Sikhandini.
Sikhandini, newly transformed into a man, stands before King Drupada while courtiers react with astonishment.
A group of royal maidens secretly examine Sikhandin to confirm his masculinity for the suspicious king of Dasarna.
